morning: Where did you come from? A fresh face! Seeking a key at dawn shows true boldness!

First guest of the small hours — the quieter the time, the clearer the heart.

{nick}, back again this late. Before sleep, let at least one thing go.
{nick}, good to see you again in the small hours. Did you untie all of today's knots?
